disciplinary_grounds.description: Material deception in furnishing information to the Department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Material deception in furnishing information to the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Material violations of any provision of this Act or rules/final administrative action of the Secretary.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Material violations of any provision of this Act or violation of the rules of or final administrative action of the Secretary, after consideration of the recommendation of the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or a misdemeanor involving dishonesty or directly related to the practice of nursing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction by plea of guilty or nolo contendere, finding of guilt, jury verdict, or entry of judgment or by sentencing of any crime, including, but not limited to, convictions, preceding sentences of supervision, conditional discharge, or first offender probation, under the laws of any jurisdiction of the United States: (i) that is a felony; or (ii) that is a misdemeanor, an essential element of which is dishonesty, or that is directly related to the practice of the profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A pattern of practice or other behavior demonstrating incapacity or incompetency to practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A pattern of practice or other behavior which demonstrates incapacity or incompetency to practice under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding or assisting another person in violating any provision of this Act or rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly aiding or assisting another person in violating any provision of this Act or rules.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing within 90 days to provide a response to a written request for information from the Department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing, within 90 days, to provide a response to a request for information in response to a written request made by the Department by certified or registered mail or by email to the email address of record.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public, as defined by rule.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unlawful taking, theft, selling, distributing, or manufacturing of any drug, narcotic, or prescription device.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unlawful taking, theft, selling, distributing, or manufacturing of any drug, narcotic, or prescription device.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or addiction to alcohol, narcotics, stimulants, or other chemical agents or drugs that could result in inability to practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use or addiction to alcohol, narcotics, stimulants, or any other chemical agent or drug that could result in a licensee's inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline by another U.S. jurisdiction or foreign nation on substantially equivalent grounds.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline by another U.S. jurisdiction or foreign nation, if at least one of the grounds for the discipline is the same or substantially equivalent to those set forth in this Section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the terms of probation or conditions placed on the license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A finding that the licensee, after having her or his license placed on probationary status or subject to conditions or restrictions, has violated the terms of probation or failed to comply with such terms or conditions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being named as a perpetrator in an indicated report of child abuse or neglect, proven by clear and convincing evidence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being named as a perpetrator in an indicated report by the Department of Children and Family Services and under the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act, and upon proof by clear and convincing evidence that the licensee has caused a child to be an abused child or neglected child as defined in the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful omission to file or record, or willfully impeding the filing of medical reports as required by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful omission to file or record, or willfully impeding the filing or recording or inducing another person to omit to file or record medical reports as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to report an instance of suspected child abuse or neglect as required by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully failing to report an instance of suspected child abuse or neglect as required by the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence in the practice of practical, professional, or advanced practice registered nursing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence in the practice of practical, professional, or advanced practice registered nursing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holding oneself out to be practicing nursing under any name other than one's own.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Holding oneself out to be practicing nursing under any name other than one's own.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a licensee to report adverse final actions taken against them by another licensing jurisdiction or authority.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a licensee to report to the Department any adverse final action taken against him or her by another licensing jurisdiction of the United States or any foreign state or country, any peer review body, any health care institution, any professional or nursing society or association, any governmental agency, any law enforcement agency, or any court or a nursing liability claim related to acts or conduct similar to acts or conduct that would constitute grounds for action as defined in this Section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a licensee to report surrender of a license or membership on any staff while under disciplinary investigation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a licensee to report to the Department surrender by the licensee of a license or authorization to practice nursing or advanced practice registered nursing in another state or jurisdiction or current surrender by the licensee of membership on any nursing staff or in any nursing or advanced practice registered nursing or professional association or society while under disciplinary investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to establish and maintain records of patient care and treatment as required by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to establish and maintain records of patient care and treatment as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license or in connection with applying for renewal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license under this Act or in connection with applying for renewal of a license under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing another person or organization to use the licensee's license to deceive the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Allowing another person or organization to use the licensee's license to deceive the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making or filing false records or reports in the licensee's practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully making or filing false records or reports in the licensee's practice, including, but not limited to, false records to support claims against the medical assistance program

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to subvert or cheat on a licensing examination administered under this Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to subvert or cheat on a licensing examination administered under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct in the commission of an act including sexual abuse, sexual misconduct, or sexual exploitation related to the licensee's practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral conduct in the commission of an act, including, but not limited to, sexual abuse, sexual misconduct, or sexual exploitation, related to the licensee's practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or negligently violating the confidentiality between nurse and patient except as required by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully or negligently violating the confidentiality between nurse and patient except as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing under a false or assumed name, except as provided by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing under a false or assumed name, except as provided by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: The use of any false, fraudulent, or deceptive statement in any document connected with the licensee's practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of any false, fraudulent, or deceptive statement in any document connected with the licensee's practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Directly or indirectly giving or receiving a fee, commission, rebate, or other compensation for professional services not actually or personally rendered.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Directly or indirectly giving to or receiving from a person, firm, corporation, partnership, or association a fee, commission, rebate, or other form of compensation for professional services not actually or personally rendered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical illness, mental illness, or disability that results in inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical illness, mental illness, or disability that results in the inability to practice the profession with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exceeding the terms of a collaborative agreement or prescriptive authority delegated by the collaborating physician.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exceeding the terms of a collaborative agreement or the prescriptive authority delegated to a licensee by his or her collaborating physician or podiatric physician in guidelines established under a written collaborative agreement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false or misleading statement regarding a licensee's skill or the efficacy of medicine, treatment, or remedy prescribed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a false or misleading statement regarding a licensee's skill or the efficacy or value of the medicine, treatment, or remedy prescribed by him or her in the course of treatment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, selling, administering, or distributing a controlled substance for other than medically accepted therapeutic purposes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, selling, administering, distributing, giving, or self-administering a drug classified as a controlled substance (designated product) or narcotic for other than medically accepted therapeutic purposes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promotion of the sale of drugs, devices, appliances, or goods in a manner to exploit the patient for financial gain.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Promotion of the sale of drugs, devices, appliances, or goods provided for a patient in a manner to exploit the patient for financial gain.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating State or federal laws, rules, or regulations relating to controlled substances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating State or federal laws, rules, or regulations relating to controlled substances.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or negligently violating the confidentiality between an advanced practice registered nurse, collaborating physician, dentist, or podiatric physician and a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully or negligently violating the confidentiality between an advanced practice registered nurse, collaborating physician, dentist, or podiatric physician and a patient, except as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to report an instance of suspected abuse, neglect, financial exploitation, or self-neglect of an eligible adult as required by the Adult Protective Services Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully failing to report an instance of suspected abuse, neglect, financial exploitation, or self-neglect of an eligible adult as defined in and required by the Adult Protective Services Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being named as an abuser in a verified report under the Adult Protective Services Act, proven by clear and convincing evidence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being named as an abuser in a verified report by the Department on Aging and under the Adult Protective Services Act, and upon proof by clear and convincing evidence that the licensee abused, neglected, or financially exploited an eligible adult as defined in the Adult Protective Services Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A violation of any provision of this Act or any rules adopted under this Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of any provision of this Act or any rules adopted under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the Compassionate Use of Medical Cannabis Program Act.

definition_quote.value: Registered professional nursing practice means a scientific process founded on a professional body of knowledge that includes, but is not limited to, the protection, promotion, and optimization of health and abilities, prevention of illness and injury, development and implementation of the nursing plan of care, facilitation of nursing interventions to alleviate suffering, care coordination, and advocacy in the care of individuals, families, groups, communities, and populations.
definition_quote.quote: "Registered professional nursing practice" means a scientific process founded on a professional body of knowledge that includes, but is not limited to, the protection, promotion, and optimization of health and abilities, prevention of illness and injury, development and implementation of the nursing plan of care, facilitation of nursing interventions to alleviate suffering, care coordination, and advocacy in the care of individuals, families, groups, communities, and populations.

value: Development and implementation of nursing plan of care
Ordering diagnostic and therapeutic tests and procedures (APRN)
Ordering treatments and applying medical devices (APRN)
methods_authorized.quote: The scope of practice of an advanced practice registered nurse includes, but is not limited to, each of the following: (1) Advanced nursing patient assessment and diagnosis. (2) Ordering diagnostic and therapeutic tests and procedures... (3) Ordering treatments, ordering or applying appropriate medical devices... (6) Prescriptive authority as defined in Section 65-40 of this Act.

drug_authority.value: APRNs with a written collaborative agreement may be delegated authority to prescribe Schedule III-V controlled substances and, under specific conditions, Schedule II by oral/topical/transdermal routes. APRNs with full practice authority may prescribe Schedule II-V controlled substances; Schedule II narcotic drugs (e.g., opioids) only in a consultation relationship with a physician. APRNs in hospitals/hospital affiliates may be privileged to prescribe Schedule II-V controlled substances. CRNAs may select, order, and administer medication including controlled substances for anesthesia services under agreed anesthesia plan.
drug_authority.quote: authority to prescribe both legend drugs and Schedule II through V controlled substances; this authority includes prescription of, selection of, orders for, administration of, storage of, acceptance of samples of, and dispensing over the counter medications, legend drugs, and controlled substances categorized as any Schedule II through V controlled substances

value: Schedule II controlled substances (with full practice authority, oral/topical/transdermal only for opioids, in consultation with physician)

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: APRNs with full practice authority may prescribe Schedule II narcotic drugs (such as opioids) only in a consultation relationship with a physician; specific drug must be identified by brand or generic name; only by oral dosage or topical/transdermal application (not injection); at least monthly the APRN and physician must discuss patients for whom an opioid is prescribed.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: prescribing Schedule II narcotic drugs, such as opioids, only in a consultation relationship with a physician; this consultation relationship shall be recorded in the Prescription Monitoring Program website... the specific Schedule II narcotic drug, such as an opioid, may be administered by oral dosage or topical or transdermal application; delivery by injection or other route of administration is not permitted; at least monthly, the advanced practice registered nurse and the physician must discuss the condition of any patients for whom an opioid is prescribed

whistleblower_protection_for_delegation_.quote: Nurses shall not be subject to disciplinary or any other adverse action for refusing to delegate a nursing intervention based on patient safety.
